text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-INC-9273: > 5m sustained 429 spike from api.prod across multiple customers. Alert source: rate-limiter-service (quota-mapper).

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD-INC-9273. Escalation policy: oncall-sre. Paging alice.

alice: acked. I'm on it. Joining call in 2.

bob: saw the 429 dashboard. Top traces show `quota_mapper.apply()` latency spikes and `quota-lookup` errors to redis-cluster-legacy.

carla: pinging runtime logs now. grep shows a flood of `quota-not-found` for tenant IDs that should be handled by dedicated-pool routing. Looks like the mapper returned a default quota (strict) instead of tenant-specific.

alice: important question — is this a capacity problem or a config bug? Are we hitting real throttles or misapplied quotas?

dave: we have at least 6 customers reporting errors via support; all return 429s in the last 10m. Support has queued them under INC-9273-CX.

eve: customer-impact: some L2 clients are degraded; internal health shows request success rate dropped from 99.6% to 88% in ap-east region.

bob: running quick redis check: `redis-cli -h redis-cluster-legacy info replication` shows a partial partitioning; one replica lagging, causing mapper fallback path that looks up fallback-quota key.

carla: posting relevant logs:
```
2026-03-14T18:05:11Z quota-mapper ERROR tenant_lookup failed: ERR READONLY You can't write against a read only replica
2026-03-14T18:05:11Z quota-mapper WARN fallback to default_quota strict=true
2026-03-14T18:05:12Z rate-limiter INFO applying quota default_quota for tenant t-42
```

alice: ok this reads like a redis topology/replica read-only causing fallback to a default strict quota. That would explain new throttles for tenants that should've used relaxed dedicated quotas.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-9273 -> alice acknowledged at 2076543222. Escalation paused.

alice: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable quota-mapper fallback behavior to stop applying default strict quota 2) whitelist known impacted tenants to bypass limiter and 3) restore redis cluster replica/replicaset so primary is writable. I'm going to run step 1 now (toggle feature flag).

carla: note: toggling fallback is a hotfix with small risk — it will cause some requests to pass without quota checks (ok for short window).

alice: running `curl -X POST https://api.internal/flags/quota_mapper_disable_fallback -d '{"value":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer token'` -> 200 OK.

bob: applying tenant whitelist for top 4 impacted customers: sending command to rate-limiter admin endpoint `POST /admin/whitelist` with list.

carla: whitelist applied. Confirming by tails of limiter logs: `whitelist bypass for tenant t-42 true`

alice: redis replica resync in progress: `kubectl exec -n infra redis-legacy-0 -- redis-cli SLAVEOF redis-legacy-master 6379` -> resync logs show catch-up.

dave: support note drafted for CX: "We're aware of increased 429 responses starting ~18:04 UTC. Root cause related to internal quota service temporarily falling back to strict defaults. We have applied mitigations and will follow up with a postmortem. If you're still seeing errors please share request IDs." Want me to send now?

eve: yes please send. Keep message neutral, no mention of replica until later.

dave: sent to affected customers. Copy of message: "We have applied temporary mitigations to reduce throttling and are monitoring. We expect full recovery within 30 minutes."

bob: metrics: 429 rate fell from 12% -> 1.5% within 90s of toggle and whitelist. Token throughput returned to normal for whitelisted tenants. Non-whitelisted tenants see tapering as redis replica catches up.

alice: monitoring shows recovery. Keeping incident open for verification and for a durable fix. I'm handing over to bob for remediation and postmortem. If anything spikes again, page me.

bob: taking over. Next actions: 1) remove unsafe fallback code from mapper and rollout patch behind safe flag 2) add tighter guard for read-only redis detection to avoid silent fallback 3) add alert to differentiate fallback-induced throttles vs real capacity throttles.

carla: I'll prepare a runtime patch ready for canary in staging. Need 2h for code + tests.

dave: support message update: "We're monitoring and will follow up with a timeline. No customer data exposed; only request rate was impacted."

eve: product: collecting top affected tenants to prioritize rollback/compensation if needed.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-9273 -> status: mitigated, oncall bob assigned for remediation.

alice: closing incident in 30m unless regression. Great job team :thumbsup:.

bob: note for postmortem: potential contributing factor — recent config deploy that added `legacy_redis_failover` flag two days ago. Saving deploy diffs now: `git show origin/main~3..origin/main -- path/services/quota-mapper`

carla: tagging p0 test case for QA: "simulate redis replica read-only -> fallback to default quota".

alice: handoff completed at 2076543299.

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-9273 closed by alice at 2076543350 (status: mitigated).
